maya: Quick flag — QuotaPilot renewal quote looks off. Their invoice put 300k credits under a `trial pool` line and we still got an overage charge. Can someone who negotiated with them confirm whether committed credits should auto-offset usage? @procurement-bot
caleb: Can you paste the invoice lines or screenshot?
maya: Pasted the relevant lines below:
```
QuotaPilot Invoice (2026-03)
SKU: committed-credits-100k  — -$10,000
SKU: trial-pool-credits-300k — $0
Usage (embeddings): 1.2M tokens — $2,400
Total due: $2,400
Invoice ID: QP-INV-4821
```
erica: ugh — looks like they classified the credits wrong. In our SOW committed credits should offset usage first, trial pool is a separate promo. We need the original quote + contract id to confirm. @procurement-bot can you pull the quote and contract extract? :thinking_face:
procurement-bot: Created ticket PROD-5893 for QuotaPilot invoice/renewal review. Labels: vendor-credits, billing. ETA: 2 business days.
caleb: Also flagging pricing model differences — QuotaPilot is commit+burst. MeterFlux (our other eval) offered straight usage tiers. We should ask QuotaPilot for a conversion table (committed credits -> effective discount) so we can compare apples-to-apples.
maya: Our ask to vendor: (1) confirm committed credits are applied to usage first; (2) pro-rate or convert unused trial credits to committed credits for the renewal; (3) clarify capped overage rate. Should we push for a 12mo true-up or a rollover?
erica: push for pro-rate + 12mo true-up or 6mo automatic conversion. Also request a written cap on overage (e.g., no more than 2x list). Get them to commit to delivering token-level usage exports monthly.
caleb: I'll draft the message to the rep. Draft bullets: 1) confirm credit application order in contract; 2) provide conversion math for trial -> committed; 3) propose a rollover/pro-rate mechanism; 4) include a max overage multiplier and monthly token export.
maya: adding the invoice PDF to the ticket: https://files.redwood.internal/qpilot/invoices/QP-INV-4821.pdf  — thanks.
procurement-bot: Ticket PROD-5893 updated. Assignee: caleb. Next steps: draft vendor ask, legal review for contract amendment, and request accounting hold on the disputed charge until resolution.
erica: +1 on hold and legal sign-off.
caleb: will post the vendor message in the thread once drafted.
maya: thanks all — keeping this thread in vendors so finance + procurement can weigh in. :thumbsup:
